name: Allied Blenders and Distillers Ltd
title: Allied Blenders and Distillers Ltd - 544203 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record FY26 EBITDA ₹568 crore (14.4% margin) driven by premium mix and pricing, but management guides only flat FY27 margins with Q1 pressure, and supply-side evidence is largely capex-led backward integration rather than capacity discipline.

capex.quote: Malt Distilleryproject in Telangana is expected to become operational during H1 FY27.

triggers.label: Telangana price increase pending
triggers.quote: the price increase will definitely come through

triggers.label: FY28 EBITDA margin guide raised to 18%
triggers.quote: we have increased by 100 basis points to 18%, and we will stay with that guidance

triggers.label: Inventory days rose on Scotch buying
triggers.quote: we have done some proactive buying of scotch

triggers.label: Q1 margin contraction expected
triggers.quote: we will see some bit of margin contraction in Q1, early Q2

guidance.quote: we expect the top line growth at a consolidated level to be in the range of mid- teens
the FY27 overall margins, we should be hold on to the FY26, if not better it
we have increased by 100 basis points to 18%, and we will stay with that guidance
we expect P&A category to grow at high teens by FY28

guidance.value: net debt/EBITDA below 2x; net debt/equity below 0.75x
guidance.quote: we do not intend breaching these covenants at all

red_flags.label: Telangana receivables and overdues
red_flags.quote: we are seeing reduction both in the overall receivables and in the overdue receivables

red_flags.label: Inventory days rising
red_flags.quote: This year, our inventory days have gone up.

evasions.quote: Whether it will happen in the next 2 months or not is not the way we are looking at.
